notes.title: Epic Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Zachypoo here, I worked on this update for a couple of hours, and here are the patch notes.
[/h2]

[list]
[*] House #2's Door is now a [b]Boss Door[/b] lol.
[*] A [b]Water Bucket[/b] is added.
[*] Ball Fart Death Dungeon now has [b]another room[/b].
[*] A couple of [b]chests[/b] have been added.
[*] added some [b]useful text[/b] about what level you need to be.
[*] Villagers no longer [b]reset completely[/b] on death, they still get removed on death.
[/list]
